describe.behavior: Emit the exact backwards-compatible PyRunway Protocol V1 version 1.2 discovery projection after verifying installed contract, discovery projection, and runtime binding identities.

contract.behavior: Emit this complete governed semantic contract after verifying installed contract, discovery projection, and runtime binding identities.

standalone.behavior: Run an existing non-symlink Python script outside project semantics through installation-bound physical uv and standalone Python executables, with isolated/no-project/no-config/offline/no-download execution and scrubbed inherited Python/uv/shell environment authority.

project.behavior: Discover the nearest ancestor pyproject.toml from cwd, require its existing canonical non-symlink .venv environment, bind uv to that project and environment, scrub inherited Python/uv environment authority, and execute Python through bound uv. Normal mode may synchronize the existing canonical project environment; it does not create a missing canonical environment. Strict mode requires the same existing canonical environment without synchronization.
project.strict_behavior: Require an existing non-symlink canonical .venv, use no-sync/offline/no-python-downloads, and verify sys.executable is lexically inside that canonical environment before target execution.

trust_bootstrap.shell_mode: privileged (-p) to suppress BASH_ENV and imported shell-function authority before script code
